measurement_policy.lanius: warm daemon edit job including request, source load, compile, and artifact write
measurement_policy.native: clean build; cleanup occurs before timed interval; default compiler parallelism
measurement_policy.native_source_variation: a semantics-neutral entry-source marker changes for every sample

measurement_policy.zig_cache: fresh local build cache per sample; persistent compiler-global cache; one unmeasured primer per lane
